notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).
CHAT (FastAPI) and INTERACTION (Flask) read PostgreSQL; INTERACTION (Flask) also enqueues SQS tasks, starts Temporal workflows and makes API calls to CRM + workspace APIs.

AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers and SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers long-poll SQS; AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers also read PostgreSQL; SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers also read + write PostgreSQL; and also SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers enqueue follow-up SQS tasks.
